# SCF energies: the minao column is the absolute energy (Eh) obtained from the minao initial guess. The columns of the other initial guesses (atom, huckel, and RHF = UHF started from the RHF/ROHF orbitals) are differences from the minao energy of the same method, E(guess) - E(minao), in mEh; a negative value means that guess gave a lower energy than minao.

# CCSD energies: total energies (Eh) of CCSD calculations that use the lowest SCF solution as the reference: the lowest RHF/ROHF solution for 'on RHF/ROHF' and the lowest UHF solution for 'on UHF' (the guess named in the 'best' column), not necessarily the minao solution. Exception: the CCSD reference is a lower SCF solution than any guess of this table reached (it was obtained from the orbitals of an earlier calculation) for AlFH4MnOSi (d03a), RHF/ROHF: -10.26 mEh relative to the lowest guess in the table.
# Data and scripts (geometries, SCF and CCSD inputs and outputs; this table is written by dz/make_summary.py): https://github.com/zh-yichi/ms_tm

# *   on a CCSD energy: the CCSD did not converge within the maximum number of cycles; the energy of the last cycle is given and should not be used as a converged value [on RHF/ROHF: BeCH5MnNSi (4ac7), CFeH (b223), H4MnPSi (6b3f)].

# *   on a minao SCF energy: the SCF from the minao guess converged to an internally unstable solution (a saddle point, not a minimum); its energy is still the reference of the relative energies of that row, but minao is not the guess to use [RHF/ROHF: CHMn (a29d)].

# n/a no energy is available: the calculation failed or was not run (for CCSD: the amplitudes diverged and the run stopped with an error; for an SCF guess: not converged, unstable or missing) [on RHF/ROHF: H2NiSi (fe9c)].
